parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualitySignalTests.swift`. The methods `QualitySignalTests.recoveryMagnitudeRapidCooling` (line 206) and `QualitySignalTests.recoveryScaleAcceleratesRecovery` (line 223) are distinct test cases that, despite a Jaccard similarity of 0.75, are intentionally exercising different behavioural scenarios of the same quality-signal domain (rapid cooling vs. accelerating recovery). Collapsing or deduplicating them would obscure the distinct test intent and reduce diagnostic clarity when either scenario fails.
